about: FactoryReset (types/0x0001-device.md §3.3): refused without the LAGN magic; acknowledged from the old address, carried out 50 ms later. Without a restart hook the node forgets its address, restores the system settings and joins again; the Device event sequence goes on.

steps.note: a changed Diagnostics setting, to see it restored
done: no address, next announcement at 250 + 1500 % 1000
the old address is not ours any more
a new address; Booted carries sequence 1
ReportInterval of Diagnostics is back at its default
